ev.q: This report describes the first transfusion-associated WNV infection identified in 2004
Individual NAT was reactive in nine of 10 replicated tests.
a minipool including this plasma unit was reconstructed and was reactive in two of 10 replicated minipool NAT tests
As of September 7, a total of 98 blood components potentially containing WNV had been removed
In July 2004, a man aged 43 years was admitted to a tertiary-care hospital
